title: Idea Backlog
description: IDEATE-stage exit artifact. A deterministically ranked MENU of ideas for the director to choose from. Legacy runs rank by feasibility; strict idea-investment-memo runs rank by a transparent scientific_investment composite in which feasibility is only one bounded signal. Every idea carries a feasibility score and at least one non-blank evidence_ref (anti-slop). HARD: this schema contains NO selected/chosen/bet/winner/director_* field, and every object is additionalProperties:false, so the producing model cannot self-bet. The bet is recorded ONLY by the human /idea-bet gate as a separate adr.

ranked_ideas.description: Ideas ranked by the active declared policy (scientific investment for strict runs; feasibility for legacy runs). The director picks via the /idea-bet gate.

idea_id.description: Unique identifier for this idea, e.g. IDEA-001

rank.description: Deterministic menu rank under the active policy; never a bet or approval.

summary.description: One-sentence summary of the research idea (non-blank)

score.description: Feasibility score in [0, 1]; higher = more feasible

compute.description: Compute demand signal used in the rubric (e.g. 'low', 'high', or a numeric estimate)

data.description: Data availability signal used in the rubric

time.description: Time-to-result signal used in the rubric

scientific_investment.description: Optional on legacy artifacts; required by the strict idea-investment-memo/v2 operated contract. Transparent components preserve why the menu was ordered.

evidence_ref.description: Anti-slop: references to hypothesis_ids, gap_ids, or sources backing this idea. At least one required; each must be non-blank.

from_hypothesis_ref.description: Optional: the hypothesis_id this idea was derived from. Must look like a real ref (contain a digit) — this blocks smuggling a flag-word ('SELECTED'/'WINNER') through a free-text field.

novelty_ref.description: Optional: the gap_id whose novelty_score informed this idea. Must contain a digit (real-ref guard).

caveats.description: Optional list of known limitations or risks for this idea (free text; never read as a control signal)
